nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Recebe do DC Handler (branch 2 - contacts trigger) OU do fluxo digitacao (via=text_input). Query: leadId, leadName, telefone, bsuid, name_contact, first_name_contact, via, webinar_slug

nodes.name: Sanitize
nodes.notes: Normaliza dados: strip nao-digitos do phone; nome com fallback vCard>firstName>WA profile; via=native_button|text_input

parameters.query:
=WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    '{{ $('Sanitize').item.json.bsuid }}'::text AS in_bsuid,
    '{{ $('Sanitize').item.json.telefone_limpo }}'::text AS in_tel,
    '{{ $('Sanitize').item.json.webinar_slug }}'::text AS in_slug,
    '{{ $('Sanitize').item.json.nome }}'::text AS in_nome,
    COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $('Sanitize').item.json.via }}',''), 'native_button')::text AS in_via
),
existing_by_phone AS (
  SELECT * FROM rastreio_whats.contatos
  WHERE telefone = (SELECT in_tel FROM input)
    AND webinar_slug = (SELECT in_slug FROM input)
  LIMIT 1
),
bsuid_row AS (
  SELECT * FROM rastreio_whats.contatos
  WHERE bsuid = (SELECT in_bsuid FROM input)
    AND webinar_slug = (SELECT in_slug FROM input)
    AND telefone IS NULL
  LIMIT 1
),
consolidated AS (
  UPDATE rastreio_whats.contatos a SET
    bsuid = COALESCE(a.bsuid, (SELECT bsuid FROM bsuid_row)),
    ctwaclid = COALESCE(NULLIF(a.ctwaclid,''), (SELECT ctwaclid FROM bsuid_row)),
    source_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(a.source_id,''), (SELECT source_id FROM bsuid_row)),
    id_datacrazy = COALESCE(NULLIF(a.id_datacrazy,''), (SELECT id_datacrazy FROM bsuid_row)),
    nome = COALESCE(NULLIF(a.nome,''), NULLIF((SELECT in_nome FROM input),''), (SELECT nome FROM bsuid_row)),
    phone_shared_at = COALESCE(a.phone_shared_at, NOW()),
    phone_shared_via = COALESCE(a.phone_shared_via, (SELECT in_via FROM input)),
    phone_requested_at = COALESCE(a.phone_requested_at, (SELECT phone_requested_at FROM bsuid_row))
  WHERE a.telefone = (SELECT in_tel FROM input)
    AND a.webinar_slug = (SELECT in_slug FROM input)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bsuid_row)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_by_phone)
  RETURNING a.identifier, a.telefone, a.bsuid, a.nome, a.phone_shared_via, 'CONSOLIDATED'::text AS acao
),
deleted AS (
  DELETE FROM rastreio_whats.contatos
  WHERE bsuid = (SELECT in_bsuid FROM input)
    AND webinar_slug = (SELECT in_slug FROM input)
    AND telefone IS NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consolidated)
  RETURNING bsuid
),
simple_update AS (
  UPDATE rastreio_whats.contatos SET
    telefone = (SELECT in_tel FROM input),
    nome = COALESCE(NULLIF(nome,''), NULLIF((SELECT in_nome FROM input),'')),
    phone_shared_at = NOW(),
    phone_shared_via = (SELECT in_via FROM input)
  WHERE bsuid = (SELECT in_bsuid FROM input)
    AND webinar_slug = (SELECT in_slug FROM input)
    AND telefone IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_by_phone)
  RETURNING identifier, telefone, bsuid, nome, phone_shared_via, 'UPDATED'::text AS acao
),
audit AS (
  INSERT INTO rastreio_whats.contatos (bsuid, telefone, webinar_slug, nome, status, mensagem, phone_shared_at, phone_shared_via, criado_em_br, criado_em_co)
  SELECT (SELECT in_bsuid FROM input), (SELECT in_tel FROM input), (SELECT in_slug FROM input),
    NULLIF((SELECT in_nome FROM input),''),
    'orphan_contact_shared',
    'contact_shared recebido mas nao achou bsuid_row + nao existia phone_row',
    NOW(),
    (SELECT in_via FROM input),
    NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo',
    NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota'
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bsuid_row)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_by_phone)
  ON CONFLICT (identifier, webinar_slug) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING identifier, telefone, bsuid, nome, phone_shared_via, 'ORPHAN_INSERTED'::text AS acao
)
SELECT * FROM consolidated
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM simple_update
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM audit

nodes.name: Merge/Update phone
nodes.notes: CTE consolidada: se ja existe linha (phone,slug), funde bsuid+ctwaclid nela e deleta linha bsuid (evita conflito PK). Senao, UPDATE simples SET telefone+nome. Grava phone_shared_at/via

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ok: true, bsuid: $('Webhook').item.json.query.bsuid, telefone: $('Webhook').item.json.query.telefone, resultado: $('Merge/Update phone').all().map(x=>x.json.acao) }) }}

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: Retorna ok + array de acoes executadas (CONSOLIDATED/UPDATED/ORPHAN_INSERTED)

parameters.content:
## ✅ Fluxo: Contato Compartilhado (BSUID → phone)
Cliente clicou no botão "Compartir contacto" nativo do Meta.
Este workflow recebe o telefone real + BSUID e atualiza o Postgres.

**Chamado por:** DC Handler bloco H2 (branch 2, condition type=contacts)
**Também chamado por:** workflow "Contato Digitado" (fallback text_input)

### 1️⃣ Recebe telefone compartilhado
Query params:
- `telefone` — formato Meta `+55 19 99739-6902`
- `bsuid` — do webhook `from_user_id`
- `name_contact` / `first_name_contact` — do vCard
- `leadName` — profile WA (fallback)
- `via` — `native_button` (default) ou `text_input`

### 3️⃣ Sanitize
- Strip non-digits do phone (`+55 19 99...` → `5519997...`)
- Nome com fallback: vCard > firstName > WA profile
- via default `native_button`

### 4️⃣ Merge SQL (CTE)
**3 caminhos possíveis:**
- **CONSOLIDATED**: já existia linha `(phone, slug)` E linha `(bsuid, slug)`. Funde bsuid+ctwaclid na existente, deleta linha bsuid (evita conflito PK)
- **UPDATED**: só existia linha bsuid. UPDATE SET telefone; identifier recalcula pra phone
- **ORPHAN_INSERTED**: nenhuma linha existia. Cria nova com flag orphan pra investigar

Grava `phone_shared_at=NOW()` + `phone_shared_via`

### 5️⃣ Respond
Retorna array de ações executadas.
DC Handler aplica tag `phone_resolvido` no próximo bloco (AOK).
